findings.issue: הִטֹּחַ is niphal infinitive construct (be plastered); אֶת marks הַבָּיִת as patient. Active enlucir makes the house the object of an active plastering.
נִרְפָּא is niphal perfect 3ms with הַנָּגַע as subject (the plague was healed). sanó la plaga continues the priest as subject and makes the plague the object he heals.

notes: Cognate viniendo viniere, viere, se extendió la plaga, and purificará el sacerdote la casa match the remaining stems and participants.
